name: Sojourner
missionSummary: Sojourner, delivered by Mars Pathfinder, became the first rover to operate on another planet and proved mobile surface science on Mars was feasible.
missionObjective: Demonstrate low-cost Mars landing and rover operations while analyzing rocks and soil in Ares Vallis.
keyAchievements: First successful rover operations on Mars.
Returned hundreds of images and in-situ elemental measurements.
Operated far beyond its planned 7-sol surface mission.

name: Spirit
missionSummary: Spirit, one of NASA's twin Mars Exploration Rovers, studied Gusev Crater for evidence of past water activity and environmental change.
missionObjective: Characterize rocks and soils and search for signs of past water-driven processes.
keyAchievements: Found strong evidence of hydrothermal and water-altered environments.
Operated from 2004 to 2010, far beyond a 90-sol design life.
Traversed diverse terrain in Gusev Crater and Columbia Hills.

name: Opportunity
missionSummary: Opportunity explored Meridiani Planum and delivered major discoveries about ancient water and long-term habitability on Mars.
missionObjective: Investigate geology and search for evidence that liquid water once persisted at the surface.
keyAchievements: Confirmed sedimentary rocks formed in ancient wet environments.
Operated nearly 15 years after a planned 90-sol mission.
Traveled more than a marathon distance on Mars.

imageSource.title: NASA Mars Exploration Rover Image Archive

name: Curiosity
missionSummary: Curiosity (Mars Science Laboratory) studies Gale Crater to determine whether ancient Mars could have supported microbial life.
missionObjective: Assess ancient habitability through geology, climate, and organic chemistry measurements.
keyAchievements: Found ancient lakebed environments with key ingredients for life.
Detected organic molecules in Martian rocks.
Documented climate and radiation conditions relevant to future exploration.

name: Perseverance
missionSummary: Perseverance (Mars 2020) explores Jezero Crater, seeks signs of ancient life, and caches samples for possible return to Earth.
missionObjective: Search for biosignatures, characterize geology and climate, and collect samples for future return missions.
keyAchievements: Collected and sealed multiple sample tubes for future Mars Sample Return work.
Demonstrated oxygen production from Mars atmosphere via MOXIE.
Mapped and analyzed delta deposits and crater-floor geology.

name: Ingenuity
missionSummary: Ingenuity, carried to Mars with Perseverance, achieved the first powered, controlled flight on another world and expanded aerial scouting concepts.
missionObjective: Demonstrate powered flight in Mars' thin atmosphere as a technology pathfinder.
keyAchievements: Performed first controlled powered flight on another planet (April 19, 2021).
Completed many flights beyond its original demonstration plan.
Provided aerial reconnaissance that informed rover path planning.
